summary.text: Sothera is a former star and now a supervoid at the center of the Sothera system in the Edge, the main setting of Edge of Eternities.

bio.text: Sothera's star strayed into a cloud of aether, became a red giant and collapsed, scouring its nearest planets, and the Kav began a species-wide project to emigrate.
Pinnacle then came to the system, built the eternity column Infinite Guideline and opened the system to the Edge.
The Monoists induced Sothera's collapse into a supervoid, making it their thousandth.
The Celestial Palatinate sent Sunstar Free Company knights to drive out the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin to reignite it, and the Dawnsire and Candela were sent to revive the supervoid.

status.text: In the latest material Sothera is a collapsing place whose light is not yet gone, still contested by Monoists and the Sunstar, and one flavor text simply says it collapses.

rejected.text: Monoists, the Free Company and others contested the system, and Tezzeret, ejected into the Edge, hired Sami and Tannuk for a mission there.
